_about: Held-out L3 substitutes for eval_diag --l3-variant. Every asset here is used by no C15 task file at any level (checked against mani_skill/envs/tasks/tabletop/object_gallery_catalog.json). attrs are set on the L3 env before reset; reset reconfigures the scene. Check each one visually first: python -m examples.baselines.act.c15_diag.env_sanity --render-variant <name>

StirSpoon_markpen.replaces: stirring tool 086_woodenblock id 1 (stretched block) -> 058_markpen id 0 at its native size
StirSpoon_markpen.note: bowl pinned to the training-scene bowl, so only the tool differs from the L3 training scene. Compare with original at --l3-flag off.

StirSpoon_screwdriver.replaces: stirring tool 086_woodenblock -> 032_screwdriver id 0 (a C30 task asset, never seen by a C15 model)
StirSpoon_screwdriver.note: backup if the marker does not sit in the mug.

PlaceMugRack_coaster.replaces: mug target 003_plate id 0 -> 019_coaster id 0 at its native size
PlaceMugRack_coaster.note: L3 success is mug-to-target distance <= 0.1, unchanged.

PlaceFileFolder_basket.note: the task code hard-codes this target's scale (0.2, replace_scale=True); check the render before trusting results.
